generateCommentActions.temperatureReason: Conditional asynchronous child of the hot create-comment path; keeping it HOT avoids a hidden hot-to-cold transition when the existing AI feature is enabled.

listCommentActions.temperatureReason: Issue ActivityTimeline mounts useCommentActions and loads this endpoint on issue view/comment changes, including when actions are unavailable.

resolveCommentAction.temperatureReason: Issue activity action acceptance performs an issue update; it is part of the same issue-comment UI flow.

startCommentActions.temperatureReason: Successful issue-comment creation calls this helper, and it reads workspaceData before testing the optional AI policy.
